title: rosa atropurpurea
intro: Rosa atropurpurea, commonly known as the Purple Rose or Dark-leafed Rose, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and providing antioxidant benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rosa atropurpurea include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
